name: pipeline
description: Triage a lead pipeline and say who needs action today: replied means send the scheduling link, link sent 24h ago without a booking means nudge, awaiting reply means check inbound, going cold means follow up, booked means close out. Ranked and draft-first, so the owner edits before anything goes out. Triggers: "/pipeline", "work my leads", "who is stuck in the funnel".
